summary: Frontend-only regression test of the 7 focus items. 6/7 pass fully. 1 partial fail: /product/comfort-dinner-chicken (Shopify handle form) still shows 'Product not found' because Shopify API returns 404 for that handle AND the local Mongo /products/{handle} fallback also 404s (Mongo products only expose product_id like 'cd-chicken' and their handle field is null). The primary /product/cd-chicken (Mongo product_id) now works — that is the fix the user was asked to verify.

minor.issue: Returns 404. Local Mongo product docs have handle=null; only product_id ('cd-chicken') is indexed. Fallback in catalog.js therefore doesn't help when user navigates using the Shopify storefront handle.

integration_issues.issue: /product/comfort-dinner-chicken shows 'Product not found'. Shopify Storefront returns 404 for that handle and Mongo fallback also 404s because product_id != handle for Comfort Dinner variants. /product/cd-chicken works.

issues: Category tab strip is horizontally scrollable. All 4 tab buttons have data-testid, offsetParent!==null and non-zero width (pass criteria), BUT the rightmost 'Raw Cat Treats' tab extends from left=331 to right=426 — 36px are off-screen on 390px viewport. Not hidden but user must scroll horizontally to see the last tab fully. Not blocking, but worth polishing.

mobile_menu_tabs_390px.note: Rightmost tab right-edge=426 vs viewport=390 (scrollable strip).

monthly_bundles_inline_section.location: Inside Raw Dog Food view, after Primal Feast, before Raw Dog Treats section — matches spec.

footer_social_icons.note: Real non-# URLs from Shopify metaobjects. No img rendered because metaobject entries don't currently expose an icon URL — first-letter fallback ('I','T') is used, matching spec.

action_items: Optional: Make /product/comfort-dinner-chicken (Shopify handle) resolve. Either (a) ensure Shopify Storefront returns the product (verify handle on shop side), or (b) extend backend /api/products/{handle} to also lookup by Mongo `handle` field / a slug map that includes 'comfort-dinner-chicken' → 'cd-chicken'. Currently catalog.js fallback only helps when handle == product_id.

Minor: On mobile /menu the rightmost 'Raw Cat Treats' tab overflows viewport by ~36px. Container is scrollable so tab is still reachable; consider reducing horizontal padding or gap so all 4 tabs fit in 390px.
critical_code_review_comments: catalog.js Mongo fallback assumes handle == product_id. Real Shopify handles (e.g. 'comfort-dinner-chicken') will still 404 through both paths. A slug/handle→product_id map in Mongo would make this robust.
Non-blocking: LandingPage renders somewhere (console warns: 'An empty string was passed to the src attribute'). Should render null when URL missing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 mobile menu tabs have data-testid category-dog-food / category-dog-treats / category-cat-food / category-cat-treats. Bundle prices use [data-testid^='bundle-price-']. Monthly Bundles section title is .menu-collection-title with text 'Monthly Bundles' rendered between Primal Feast and Raw Dog Treats in the Raw Dog Food view. /product/cd-chicken now resolves via Mongo fallback; /product/comfort-dinner-chicken still 404s (see action item).
rca_of_the_issue: PDP 404 on /product/comfort-dinner-chicken: catalog.js getProductByHandle first calls Shopify Storefront which returns 404 (handle not in Shopify catalog OR not published), then falls back to GET /api/products/comfort-dinner-chicken. Backend /api/products/{key} looks up by product_id in Mongo; Mongo products have product_id='cd-chicken' and handle=null, so lookup fails → 404 → UI shows 'Product not found'. Fix: either publish/rename Shopify handle, or extend backend product lookup to also match Mongo `handle` or a slug alias table.
